summary: KT Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing a cash dividend of KRW 600 per common share (approx. US$0.45), representing a 1.01% yield, with total payout of KRW 143.86 billion (US$108M). Record date is May 27, 2026; payment date June 11, 2026. The board resolved on May 12, 2026 with all 7 outside directors present. FY2026 minimum DPS guidance set at KRW 2,400. This is a routine quarterly dividend, but the pre-announced policy and share buyback under trust agreement tie it to a broader capital return program. No special situation beyond ordinary course—classified as Capital Returns only because the company explicitly frames it under 'Decision for Cash Dividend Payment' with forward guidance.
